production_packet.the_scene: A suspense scene built around hiding, silence, and the threat of discovery. The performance should feel intimate and close, not theatrical.
director_notes: Keep narration and dialogue quiet, tense, and controlled.
Preserve exact text; do not add modern filler or extra lines.
Let pauses and restrained delivery carry the fear.
production_packet.sample_context: Intimate literary suspense audiobook with whispered fear and controlled protective dialogue.

provider_voice.resemble: calm literary narrator with restrained emotion
young woman, guarded and tense, with a slightly breathy voice
older man, calm and protective, controlled under pressure

scenes.title: Hiding In The Cellar
scenes.summary: Mara and Elias hide in a wet cellar while danger moves above them.
scenes.setting: wet cellar, night, floorboards groaning overhead
scenes.scene_context: A wet cellar at night. The characters are hiding below creaking floorboards while danger moves above them.
director_notes: Keep the whole scene quiet and tense, with no theatrical overplaying.
Mara must sound scared, breathless, and controlled enough to avoid being heard.
Elias must sound older, calm, and protective, but still aware of the danger.
scenes.sample_context: Intimate suspense audiobook scene with whispered fear and controlled protective dialogue.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Mara pressed her back against the cellar wall. The stones were wet, and somewhere above them the floorboards groaned.

beats.speaker: mara
beats.text: Please, just stop. If they find out we are down here, I do not know what they will do to us
beats.context: Mara whispers, afraid of being discovered.

performance.delivery: whispered panic, trying not to be heard

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Elias lifted one hand, calm but pale in the dark.

beats.speaker: elias
beats.text: Then we breathe, and we move only when the corridor goes quiet
